action: literal unadopted S5 symmetric + intrinsic S4 with once-owned YH + ordered proposed material term
distinctions: direct restriction differs from complementary elimination
positive squared solve not first-order Green solve
compact stationary inverse not retarded response
YH LL-only block zero does not zero physical YH

domain.Q: (chi,0), P_boundary G0 chi=0,(I-P_boundary)G1 chi=0 and inherited other faces/reset/causal support
domain.R: (W Phi_L,w_L), w_L=iota^sharp Phi_L a; Phi_L=Pi_L Xi T_L
domain.compact: phi_i p Xi; phi0=x(1-x),phi1=x(1-x)(2x-1); extended zero on inherited arc6..8

finite_element: integral phi_i phi_j tau_x S0+(phi_i phi_j_prime-phi_i_prime phi_j)S1/2 dx
first_order_moments: S0=(E^dagger M5 B0+B0^dagger M5 E)/2; S1=E^dagger M5 B1; E=(C W Phi_L,p Xi)
full_causal: a_QQ(zeta,X_Q^R w)=a_QR(zeta,w) for every zeta in Q; support(X_Q^R w) in J_plus support(a_QR w)
normal: B_eta=i Gamma0 Gamma4 eta; eta=-1/(2 C tan(rho/2)); B_eta^dagger=-B_eta; A5=B5-B_eta on interior compacts
other_faces: literal symmetric density additionally has -G_other/2 relative to Euler form; zero only on these compact tests
raw_and_formal: B5=Gamma0 D5; A5=(B5+B5^formal)/2; formal uses mu5 and Dirac-bar
restricted_solve: A_QQ X=A_QR; delta_A_RR=-A_RQ X; no explicit inverse/regularizer/D5daggerD5 inverse
